messages.S2・S1で充電を10以上貯め、5コインのS3「空間切断」をコイン威力+4の状態: Use S2 and S1 to build at least 10 Charge, then unleash the 5-Coin S3 Rip Space with +4 Coin Power for both clash strength and damage.
messages.S3「空間切断」: 5コイン(基本威力1、コイン威力+2)。使用時に充電回数10: **S3 — Rip Space**: 5 Coins (1 Base Power, +2 Coin Power). On use, spends 10 Charge Count to gain +4 Coin Power, reaching up to +6 per Coin. **With less than 10 Charge Count, she loses 20% of her HP.** Coin Ⅴ inflicts 5 Rupture on Heads Hit.
messages.S2「跳躍」が主な充電源: 3コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時に充電回数が4ずつ増え: **S2 Leap is her main Charge source**: 3 Coins. On hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each increase Charge Count by 4. If a Coin is broken and does not hit, she gets no Charge from it. +1 Coin Power at 7 or more Charge Count. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 1/2 Fragile on Heads Hit.
messages.S1「切断」: Ⅰコインの表面的中時に充電回数2/4を得て、表面的中時/的中時に: **S1 — Rip**: Gains 2/4 Charge Count on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit and inflicts 1 Rupture on Heads Hit/on hit. +2 Coin Power at 5 or more Charge Count. It has only 1 Coin, so she gains no Charge unless it lands Heads.
messages.充電: 最大20。ターン終了時に回数が1減少する。: **Charge**: Maximum 20. Count decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.サポートパッシブ「折られた心」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も高: **Support passive — Broken Spirit (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The first skill of the 1 fastest ally gains +1 Final Power.
messages.序盤はS2に余裕のあるマッチを任せて、コインを壊されずに充電を取る。S1は精神力: Early on, leave Clashes she can comfortably win to S2 and collect Charge without having her Coins broken. Use S1 once her SP is up, or aim for Heads with one-sided attacks. Allow for the Count lost at Turn End, bring Charge Count to 10 or more, and take the Clash with S3 Rip Space. Using it below 10 costs HP, so be especially careful in auto battle.
